name: Sesame
author: Gran Software Solutions
description: Two-factor codes in the bar: encrypted store, copy on Enter, add accounts by holding a QR code up to the webcam

barWidget.description: Click to open the code list; Enter copies. Ctrl+S scans a QR code with the webcam.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph or its hex codepoint (e.g. f099d). Empty uses the shield-key glyph.

schema.label: Clear clipboard after (seconds)
schema.description: Clear a copied code if the clipboard still holds it. 0 disables.

schema.label: Mirror the camera preview
schema.description: Selfie-style preview while scanning. Decoding is unaffected.
